description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.059 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Returns top DeFi yield pools ranked by APY from DeFiLlama. Covers 16,000+ pools across 400+ protocols and 50+ chains (Ethereum, Base, Solana, Arbitrum, Polygon, etc.). Filter by chain, minimum APY, minimum TVL, or stablecoin-only. Each pool includes APY breakdown (base + reward), TVL, 7-day APY change, and a direct DeFiLlama link. Sourced from DeFiLlama public API — no key required, updated continuously.

pools.description: Yield pools matching filters, sorted by APY descending.

apy_base.description: Base APY % (lending/protocol yield, no token rewards).

apy_reward.description: Reward APY % (token incentives on top of base).

pool_id.description: DeFiLlama pool UUID for precise reference.

stablecoin.description: True if pool is denominated in stablecoins.

total_matched.description: Total pools matching the given filters before the limit was applied.
